validation.scalar_jni_scope: Four signed widths, both constant operand orders, zero/one/1023 rows; cardinality, values and Arrow type read after input closes; 96 batches across four release/JDK pairs.

method.build: release/default features/mimalloc; JDK 17.0.12; Apple M4 Pro; one thread
method.prepared_boundary: Released generated Java on prepared GenericRowData/BinaryRowData versus production Calc on matching Arrow; operation and matching output checksum timers are inside Rust. Entry JNI/import/export and both perimeter transposes outside small-operation timing; intrinsic previous JVM computation inside.
method.previous: Actual independently compiled main encoder from base; requires a bound JVM evaluator. Candidate requires no JVM evaluator and a nonempty intended native-function route.
method.signature: Java and Arrow nullable/NOT NULL declarations match the data; nullable corpus has NULL every seven rows.
method.order: Serial paired processes; 16 warmups, nine measurements and 131072 processed rows per trial; all checksums agree.
method.pipeline: One million nullable INT rows, rowwise source/blackhole, parallelism one, two warmups/five measurements. Retains JNI, planning/startup and both transposes. Both native modes require consumed Calc; candidate requires empty JVM descriptors.
method.allocation: Untimed production probe after compilation; CountingAllocator wraps System and links through the enabled malloc=mi_malloc/free=sf_free aliases. Counts exclude JVM/C++/other-thread allocations. Timed counts are disabled, with wrapper check retained.

limits: Retain all slower small-batch cells; fixed Calc/result costs dominate tiny integer computation.
Independent stock-control and complete-job ranges are reported; process variability is not isolated causality.
